title: CWP/24306/2025 of SUSHMA Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH (215-25) Date of decision:- 21.11.2025 Sushma ... Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUVIR SEHGAL Present:- Mr. Sunil Kumar, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Pradeep Sharma, Advocate for the respondent (s)-PSPCL Mr. Maninderjit Singh Bedi, Advocate General, Punjab, Senior Advocate with Mr. Maninder Singh Garcha, Advocate Mr. Sangam Garg, Advocate and Ms. Mehak Kanwar, Advocate for respondents-PSPCL. Mr. H.P.S.Ishar, Additional Advocate General, Punjab SUVIR SEHGAL, J. (ORAL)

1. For order, see detailed reasons recorded in a separate order of even date passed in CWP-7204-2025 tilted as “Anima Maity Versus Punjab State Power Corporation Limited and others”. (SUVIR SEHGAL) JUDGE 21.11.2025 Kamal High Court, Sector-1, Chandigarh.
